questions.prompt: In the C4 model, what is the correct containment hierarchy?

options.text: A software system contains containers, which contain components, which are implemented by code
A component contains containers, which contain systems
Code contains components, which contain systems

questions.explanation: A software system is made of containers, each containing components, which are implemented by code elements; people use the systems.

options.text: A separately deployable boundary in which code runs or data is stored
A grouping of related functionality behind an interface, not separately deployable

questions.explanation: A container is a separately deployable boundary where code executes or data is stored (e.g. an application, database, microservice, mobile app).

questions.prompt: In C4, components are separately deployable units.
questions.explanation: Components are a grouping of related functionality behind a well-defined interface and are NOT separately deployable; containers are.

questions.prompt: Which two C4 diagrams are mandatory?
questions.explanation: Of the four C4 levels, the Context and Container diagrams are required; Component and Code diagrams are optional.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the Level 1 Context diagram?

options.text: To show what the system is, who uses it, and how it fits into its environment

questions.explanation: The Context diagram answers what the system is, who uses it, and how it fits with the existing environment; it is the starting point for any stakeholder.

questions.prompt: When annotating interactions between containers, which information is useful to include?

options.text: The purpose of the interaction (e.g. reads/writes data from)
The developer's name who wrote it

questions.explanation: Useful annotations on container interactions: purpose, communication mechanism, communication style, plus protocols and port numbers.

questions.prompt: Which extra piece of information must a Container record that a Context-level Software System need not?
questions.explanation: For each container you report Name, Technology (implementation technology), and Description — technology is the added detail at the container level.

questions.prompt: The C4 model is a lightweight notation for visualizing the static structure of a software system.
questions.explanation: C4 is a lightweight notation to visualize the static structure, based on a hierarchical model with four levels and four main element types.
